# docs-vault-wiki

Wiki/codebase summaries and architecture notes. Primary written
self-awareness substrate; load before any specific codebase- branch.

## Why this matters

User vault snapshots and architecture notes. Primary written self-awareness substrate from outside the codebase — the place to look when you want to know what *the user actually wrote* about an idea before it landed in code.

## What lives here

- `vault/.archive/openclaw-notes/` — OpenClaw-era integration specs (e.g. `EMA-OpenClaw-Node-Integration-Spec-2026-04-03.md`)
- `vault/.archive/host-sessions/` — narrated build sessions (e.g. place.org v0.1→v0.5)
- `vault/.archive/host-archive/LetMeScale-docs/` — earlier design notes
- `vault/.archive/inbox-trash-2026-03-18/` — captured raw context

## Where it connects

- Adjacent: `docs-host-vault-context` (host-machine vault mirror), `docs-host-obsidian-vault` (raw export)
- Inspires: nothing new (this is reference material), but informs the wiki vApp planned in `docs-ema-next-steps/.../ULTIMATE-WIKI-ARCHITECTURE.qmd`

## How to load it efficiently

Use grep across the branch first; the structure is deep:
```bash
git ls-tree -r origin/docs-vault-wiki --name-only | grep -i <topic>
git show origin/docs-vault-wiki:<path>
```
